youtube.title: Why Old Eggs Float but Fresh Ones Sink 🥚 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
An eggshell is covered in thousands of tiny pores. As an egg ages, moisture escapes and air enters through them, and the air cell at the blunt end grows larger. A bigger air pocket makes the egg less dense, so an old egg floats while a fresh one sinks. The float test is a common way to check freshness.
